title: Tonquin Fishing Charters

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Experience world-class salmon, halibut, lingcod and offshore fishing on Vancouver Island’s spectacular west coast with an experienced local fishing guide. John’s expertise and passion have consistently placed Tonquin Fishing Charters among the highest rated charters on the coast. At Tonquin Charters, we offer some of the best offshore and inshore experiences you could ask for. We offer half day, full day and multi-day trips to accommodate all your fishing needs. Read what guests are saying about their fishing adventures with us. From first catches to unforgettable days on the water, every trip comes with great memories and even better stories.
